about: Tag-Team Debate motions per level: FOR team vs AGAINST team, speakers alternate, starting with FOR. Times in seconds. M.3 is the original set (plus extras written for Kru); M.1 and M.2 were written for Kru. Spin picks a random motion, no repeats until all are used. Uses the Tag-Team Talk app (games/tag-team/app.js), which switches on mode.

intro.title: Tag-Team Debate
text: Two teams at the front: FOR vs AGAINST.
Speakers take turns, starting with FOR.

intro.title: Huddle first
text: Plan your points for 1 minute.
Think: what will the other team say?

intro.title: Answer, then add
text: First answer the last point: "I disagree because…"
Then add a new point.

rows: I disagree because dogs are noisy.

intro.title: Points
text: Challenge for silence, repeating, off topic or Thai.
The audience votes for the winning side.
